key_idea: Find how many apples were taken in all, then share that number equally between the 3 baskets.
steps: After Nora takes some, the baskets have 2 + 4 + 5 = 11 apples.
At the start there were 20 apples. 20 - 11 = 9 apples were taken.
She took the same number from each of the 3 baskets. 3 + 3 + 3 = 9.
Check: the baskets had 5, 7 and 8 apples. 5 + 7 + 8 = 20.

choice_feedback.A: Taking 1 from each basket takes only 3 apples, but 9 were taken.
choice_feedback.B: Taking 2 from each basket takes only 6 apples, but 9 were taken.
choice_feedback.D: Taking 4 from each basket takes 12 apples, but only 9 were taken.
choice_feedback.E: Taking 5 from each basket takes 15 apples, but only 9 were taken.
